description: Speaks a line in the voice of a short reference clip with Audio8-TTS and saves it as a 44.1 kHz mono wav. 'reference_audio' is the clip (an asset: reference, at most 20 s; 5-10 s of clean speech is plenty) and 'reference_text' is exactly what is said in it - both are required together. The line can be in another language than the clip: English and Russian are the model's strongest. Text and reference share a 2,048-position context, about 95 s of prompt, reference and speech together, so a line too long to fit is refused before anything runs rather than cut off; split it into shorter takes. The same 'seed' gives the same take. Consent: clone only a voice you have the right to use - your own, or one whose owner has agreed - and never to impersonate or deceive. As the model card asks, do not use it to make speech a person did not say pass as theirs.
